nb4f7417abeb.s: Which of the following is correct about the removal of the Attorney General of India?
o: He can be removed only on an order of the Supreme Court
He can be removed only by impeachment by both Houses of Parliament
He holds office during the pleasure of the President; no grounds or procedure for removal are specified
The Constitution lays down specific grounds and a special procedure for his removal
nb4f7417abeb.x: The Constitution prescribes no grounds or special procedure for removing the Attorney General; he holds office during the pleasure of the President.

n570603a1de9.s: The creation of a separate Ministry of Tribal Affairs in 1999 paved the way for a separate:
n570603a1de9.x: The separate Ministry of Tribal Affairs set up in 1999 paved the way for a separate National Commission for Scheduled Tribes.

nba327471ab2.s: Which body was set up in 2007 under a law enacted in 2005?
o: National Commission for Protection of Child Rights
nba327471ab2.x: The NCPCR was set up in 2007 under the Commissions for Protection of Child Rights Act, 2005.

n09a88a381a2.s: The National Commission for Women was constituted in:
n09a88a381a2.x: The NCW was constituted in January 1992 under the National Commission for Women Act, 1990.

n68b8cf9d224.s: Which of the following pairs regarding the National Commission for Safai Karamcharis is correctly matched?
o: Governing Act now in force — NCSK Act, 1993
n68b8cf9d224.x: The NCSK Act, 1993 lapsed in 2004, after which the NCSK continued as a non-statutory body under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.

nindian-polity-65-38.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: National Human Rights Commission — Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993
Central Information Commission — Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993
nindian-polity-65-38.x: The NHRC and SHRCs come from the Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993. The Lokpal comes from the 2013 Act, the NGT from the 2010 Act and the CIC from the RTI Act, 2005.

n16235463ccb.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The NCST is provided for under Article 338A.
2. The NCBC is provided for under Article 338B.
3. The National Commission for Women is provided for under Article 338C.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
n16235463ccb.x: The NCST (Article 338A) and NCBC (Article 338B) are constitutional bodies. The NCW is a statutory body under the NCW Act, 1990, not under any Article 338C.

n7e719e7f114.s: The NHRC cannot inquire into a matter after what period from the date of the alleged violation?
n7e719e7f114.x: The NHRC cannot inquire into a complaint after one year from the date of the alleged violation.

n34f2eea6156.s: Which of the following is NOT a function of the National Commission for Women?
o: Suggesting amendments to laws affecting women
Taking suo motu notice where women’s rights are denied
Commissioning special studies on discrimination and atrocities against women
Enforcing criminal sentences imposed by courts
n34f2eea6156.x: The NCW reviews laws, suggests amendments, takes suo motu notice and commissions special studies; it does not enforce criminal sentences imposed by courts.

nf8adb123569.s: In the context of women’s rights, ‘Jan Sunwai’ refers to:
o: An annual financial audit of women’s commissions
A public hearing of women’s grievances
A legislative session on gender budgeting
nf8adb123569.x: Jan Sunwai refers to public hearings held to hear and address women’s grievances.

n8db32c34cff.s: Which of the following functions is associated with the National Commission for Safai Karamcharis?
o: Appointing municipal commissioners in every State
Conducting the census of urban households
Monitoring the Prohibition of Employment as Manual Scavengers Act, 2013
n8db32c34cff.x: The NCSK monitors implementation of the Prohibition of Employment as Manual Scavengers Act, 2013 and reports to the Government.

n91cb11a77c7.s: Which of the following is NOT a statutory body under the Ministry of Women and Child Development?
o: National Commission for Protection of Child Rights
n91cb11a77c7.x: NCW, NCPCR and CARA are statutory bodies under the Ministry of Women and Child Development. The NCSK is under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment and has been non-statutory since 2004.

nc53fe7a7459.s: In January 2022, the Union Cabinet extended the tenure of the National Commission for Safai Karamcharis beyond 31 March 2022 by:
nc53fe7a7459.x: The Cabinet extended the NCSK for three years beyond 31 March 2022, i.e., up to 31 March 2025.

nindian-polity-1-50.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The institution of Ombudsman was first created in Sweden in 1809.
2. The First Administrative Reforms Commission was set up in 1966.
3. The First Administrative Reforms Commission recommended Lokpal and Lokayuktas.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
nindian-polity-1-50.x: All three are correct: the Ombudsman began in Sweden (1809), and the First ARC (1966) recommended Lokpal and Lokayuktas.

nindian-polity-22-48.s:
Consider the following statements about the Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act, 2013:
1. The Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha is a member of the Lokpal Selection Committee.
2. An eminent jurist is a member of the Lokpal Selection Committee.
3. The Act applies only to public servants posted within India.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
nindian-polity-22-48.x: The Leader of the Opposition and an eminent jurist sit on the Selection Committee. Statement 3 is wrong: the Act also covers public servants outside India.

n4a30c064315.s: Which of the following pairs of State and Lokayukta arrangement is correctly matched?
o: Uttar Pradesh — Officials designated as Lokpal
n4a30c064315.x: Punjab has officials designated as Lokpal. Bihar and Uttar Pradesh have only a Lokayukta, while Maharashtra has a Lokayukta and Upa-Lokayukta.

ndf44577db93.s: In August 2026, Justice (retd.) T. Mallikarjuna Rao was appointed Lokayukta of Andhra Pradesh by the:
o: Chief Justice of the Andhra Pradesh High Court
ndf44577db93.x: Governor S. Abdul Nazeer appointed him under Section 3(1) on the recommendation of the Selection Committee.

n548ed03cd50.s: Which of the following is NOT a recognised criticism or debate about the functioning of the CBI?
o: The ‘caged parrot’ description due to executive control
A constitutional bar on the CBI investigating economic offences
n548ed03cd50.x: No constitutional bar stops the CBI from investigating economic offences; it does handle them. The other three are recognised criticisms or debates.

ndfad4e6a4da.s: Which of the following pairs relating to the CBI is correctly matched?
o: OCSAE Unit — Routing requests for international police assistance
BHARATPOL portal — Handling bank securities and fraud
CBI — India’s National Central Bureau for Interpol
Economic Offences cells — Investigating online child sexual abuse material
ndfad4e6a4da.x: The CBI is India’s National Central Bureau for Interpol. OCSAE handles online child sexual abuse material, BHARATPOL routes international assistance requests, and the economic offences cells handle bank securities and fraud.

nc45d92172d3.s: Under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act, the Director of the Enforcement Directorate may:
o: Grant general consent to CBI investigations in a State
Attach property believed to be proceeds of crime
Appoint the Director of the CBI
nc45d92172d3.x: Under the PMLA, the ED Director may attach property believed to be proceeds of crime.

n4827cc24746.s:
The Committee on Policy and Programmes (1988) recommended which of the following?
1. Constitutional status for PRIs
2. A five-year term for PRIs
3. State Finance Commissions and State Election Commissions
n4827cc24746.x: The 1988 Committee recommended constitutional status, a five-year term, direct elections, and State Finance and Election Commissions.

n374e1d3076f.s: Which of the following pairs of rural reconstruction project and person is correctly matched?
n374e1d3076f.x: Sriniketan was Rabindranath Tagore’s project. Gurgaon was F.L. Brayne’s, Marthandam was Spencer Hatch’s and Baroda was V.T. Krishnamachari’s.

nafe8a460c57.s: Which of the following pairs of rural development project and person is correctly matched?
nafe8a460c57.x: Marthandam was associated with Spencer Hatch. Sevagram was Mahatma Gandhi’s, Etawah was Albert Mayer’s and Nilokheri was S.K. Dey’s.

n1b5efdc262d.s: The basic aim of the Community Development Programme was:
o: Development of villages through public participation
Establishment of Nyaya Panchayats in every village
A two-tier system of rural government
n1b5efdc262d.x: The CDP aimed to develop villages and raise rural living standards through public participation.

n899d9951a11.s: Under the Community Development Programme, the unit of planning and development headed by the Block Development Officer was the:
n899d9951a11.x: The block, covering about 100 villages, was the CDP’s unit of planning and development, headed by the BDO.

nf247d60e415.s:
Which of the following contributed to the decline of Panchayati Raj Institutions?
1. Poor finances
2. Irregular elections and supersession
3. Excessive independence from the development administration
nf247d60e415.x: Poor finances and irregular elections/supersession were causes. Excessive independence was not; the problem was bureaucratic detachment from Panchayati Raj.

n364481a2d57.s: With reference to the Ashok Mehta Committee, which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Zila Parishad — Body for a group of villages
Mandal Panchayat — Body for a group of villages
n364481a2d57.x: The Mandal Panchayat covered a group of villages. The Zila Parishad was the district-level executive body; the committee was appointed in December 1977 and reported in August 1978.

n2f3dc92c925.s:
Which of the following was/were associated with the Gadgil Committee (1988)?
1. Constitutional status for Panchayati Raj Institutions
2. Reservations in Panchayati Raj Institutions
3. Serving as the model for the 64th Constitutional Amendment Bill
n2f3dc92c925.x: The Gadgil Committee recommended constitutional status, direct elections and reservations, and its ideas were the model for the 64th Amendment Bill.

nd98e6121e34.s: Andhra Pradesh is credited with being the first State to:
o: Implement Panchayati Raj across the entire State in 1959
Give 50 per cent reservation to women in local bodies
nd98e6121e34.x: AP was the second State to adopt Panchayati Raj (1 November 1959, Shadnagar) but the first to implement it across the whole State. Rajasthan was the first to adopt it.

nindian-polity-43-10.s: Where was the three-tier Panchayati Raj system first launched on 2 October 1959?
nindian-polity-43-10.x: Nehru launched three-tier Panchayati Raj at Nagaur, Rajasthan, on 2 October 1959. Andhra Pradesh followed at Shadnagar on 1 November 1959.

nf362bb5bc15.s: Which of the following is NOT a subject in the Eleventh Schedule?
nf362bb5bc15.x: Fire services is a Twelfth Schedule (municipal) subject. Rural housing, drinking water and rural electrification are Eleventh Schedule subjects.

nd5ac34326b3.s: Which of the following pairs of Article and subject under Part IX is correctly matched?
o: Article 243D — Reservation of seats and chairpersons
nd5ac34326b3.x: Article 243D deals with reservation. Article 243A is the Gram Sabha, 243B the constitution of Panchayats and 243C their composition.
